name: Bilingual Education
summary: Bilingual Education prepares students to teach in classrooms where instruction happens in two languages, most often English and Spanish. Graduates support students as they learn content while developing both languages.
description: Bilingual Education majors study language acquisition, bilingualism and biliteracy, methods for teaching content in two languages, dual-language program models, assessment of English learners, and culturally responsive teaching. They must demonstrate strong proficiency in both languages. Field experiences take place in bilingual and dual-language classrooms, followed by student teaching, and graduates earn teaching licensure with a bilingual endorsement. With growing numbers of English learners, bilingual teachers are among the highest-need educators in many states.
